verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own docs cover Entra ID provisioning, passwordless login to Microsoft services such as Office 365, and U2F login to Google, so the key does work with some of the named identity providers. The evidence for each is little more than a page title or a one-line product claim, and enforcing hardware-key policies would be an identity-provider feature, not Nitrokey's. Missing for 10: any Okta integration evidence, Google Workspace admin-level (not just consumer Google login) integration, documented policy enforcement requiring hardware keys, depth beyond page titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the key integrates with my identity provider — Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace — and I can enforce policies requiring hardware-key authentication

citations.quote: Forget your password to log in to Microsoft services (e.g. Office 365) and Nextcloud and use Nitrokey for passwordless login instead.
Login to websites (e.g. Google, Facebook) using secure One Time Passwords (OTP), U2F or ordinary static passwords.
